sql: SELECT strftime(first_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS first, strftime(last_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS last FROM corpus_stats WHERE dataset = $1

WITH comparison_bounds AS (SELECT $1::TIMESTAMPTZ AS cf, $2::TIMESTAMPTZ AS ct, $3::TIMESTAMPTZ AS bf, $4::TIMESTAMPTZ AS bt, $5::TIMESTAMPTZ AS first_ts, $6::TIMESTAMPTZ + INTERVAL '1 microsecond' AS end_ts), comparison_coverage AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ct <= first_ts OR cf >= end_ts THEN 'none' WHEN cf >= first_ts AND ct <= end_ts THEN 'full' ELSE 'partial' END AS current, CASE WHEN bt <= first_ts OR bf >= end_ts THEN 'none' WHEN bf >= first_ts AND bt <= end_ts THEN 'full' ELSE 'partial' END AS baseline FROM comparison_bounds) SELECT current, baseline, current <> 'none' AND baseline <> 'none' AS determinable FROM comparison_coverage

WITH cur AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.pattern_id, e.pattern, e.dataset, e.component, e.ts, e.node AS u1, e.rack AS u2 FROM log_events e WHERE e.dataset = $1 AND (e.is_error OR e.is_alert) AND e.ts >= $3::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.ts < $4::TIMESTAMPTZ), episodic AS (SELECT * FROM cur MATCH_RECOGNIZE (PARTITION BY pattern_id ORDER BY ts, event_id MEASURES pattern AS pattern, dataset AS dataset, component AS component, u1 AS u1, u2 AS u2, CLASSIFIER() AS phase, MATCH_NUMBER() AS episode ALL ROWS PER MATCH AFTER MATCH SKIP PAST LAST ROW PATTERN (s n*) DEFINE n AS ts - PREV(ts) < $2::INTERVAL)), c AS (SELECT pattern_id, min(pattern) AS pattern, min(dataset) AS dataset, min(component) AS component, count(*) AS events, count(*) FILTER (WHERE phase = 's') AS episodes, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', ts)) AS active_days, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('week', ts)) AS active_weeks, CASE WHEN count(u1) = count(*) THEN count(DISTINCT u1) END AS b1, CASE WHEN count(u2) = count(*) THEN count(DISTINCT u2) END AS b2, count(DISTINCT component) AS components, min(ts) AS first_ts, max(ts) AS last_ts, min(event_id) FILTER (WHERE phase = 's' AND episode = 1) AS example_event_id FROM episodic GROUP BY pattern_id), joined AS (SELECT *, NULL::BIGINT AS baseline, NULL::BIGINT AS delta FROM c), history AS (SELECT e.pattern_id, min(e.ts) AS first_before FROM log_events e WHERE e.dataset = $1 AND (e.is_error OR e.is_alert) AND e.ts < $8::TIMESTAMPTZ AND $9::TIMESTAMPTZ < $8::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.pattern_id IN (SELECT pattern_id FROM joined) GROUP BY e.pattern_id), ruled AS (SELECT joined.*, history.first_before, episodes >= $5::BIGINT AS recurring, CASE WHEN events > 0 AND history.first_before IS NULL AND $9::TIMESTAMPTZ < $8::TIMESTAMPTZ THEN 'new' WHEN baseline > 0 AND events >= $6::BIGINT * baseline AND events - baseline >= $7::BIGINT THEN 'escalating' WHEN baseline = 0 AND events > 0 AND history.first_before IS NOT NULL THEN 'reappeared' WHEN events > 0 THEN 'ongoing' WHEN baseline > 0 THEN 'quiet' ELSE NULL::VARCHAR END AS status FROM joined LEFT JOIN history ON joined.pattern_id = history.pattern_id), totals AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(events), 0)::BIGINT AS total, coalesce(count_if(events > 0), 0) AS active, coalesce(count_if(events = 0), 0) AS quiet FROM joined), candidates AS (SELECT * FROM ruled WHERE events > 0), availability AS (SELECT count(*) AS candidates_checked, coalesce(count_if(b1 IS NULL), 0) AS missing_breadth, coalesce(count_if(delta IS NULL), 0) > 0 AS drop_increase, coalesce(count_if(b1 IS NULL), 0) > 0 AS drop_breadth FROM candidates), ranked AS (SELECT candidates.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY episodes DESC, CASE WHEN NOT drop_breadth THEN b1 END DESC, CASE WHEN NOT drop_increase THEN delta END DESC, events DESC, pattern_id ASC) AS rank FROM candidates CROSS JOIN availability), first_candidate AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rank = 1), first_comparisons AS (SELECT b.pattern_id, b.rank, (a.episodes >= b.episodes AND (drop_breadth OR a.b1 >= b.b1) AND (drop_increase OR a.delta >= b.delta) AND (a.episodes > b.episodes OR (NOT drop_breadth AND a.b1 > b.b1) OR (NOT drop_increase AND a.delta > b.delta))) AS first_dominates FROM first_candidate a CROSS JOIN ranked b CROSS JOIN availability WHERE b.rank > 1), dominance_summary AS (SELECT coalesce(count_if(NOT first_dominates), 0) AS not_dominated_by_first FROM first_comparisons), listed_conflicts AS (SELECT a.pattern_id AS a, b.pattern_id AS b, a.rank AS a_rank, b.rank AS b_rank, a.episodes > b.episodes AS a_episodes, NOT drop_breadth AND a.b1 > b.b1 AS a_breadth, NOT drop_increase AND a.delta > b.delta AS a_change, b.episodes > a.episodes AS b_episodes, NOT drop_breadth AND b.b1 > a.b1 AS b_breadth, NOT drop_increase AND b.delta > a.delta AS b_change, TRUE AS b_listed, 0 AS section FROM ranked a JOIN ranked b ON a.rank < b.rank CROSS JOIN availability WHERE b.rank <= $10::BIGINT AND NOT ((a.episodes >= b.episodes AND (drop_breadth OR a.b1 >= b.b1) AND (drop_increase OR a.delta >= b.delta) AND (a.episodes > b.episodes OR (NOT drop_breadth AND a.b1 > b.b1) OR (NOT drop_increase AND a.delta > b.delta)))) AND NOT ((b.episodes >= a.episodes AND (drop_breadth OR b.b1 >= a.b1) AND (drop_increase OR b.delta >= a.delta) AND (b.episodes > a.episodes OR (NOT drop_breadth AND b.b1 > a.b1) OR (NOT drop_increase AND b.delta > a.delta))))), outside_candidates AS (SELECT pattern_id, rank, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY rank, pattern_id) AS conflict_rank FROM first_comparisons WHERE NOT first_dominates AND rank > $10::BIGINT), outside_conflicts AS (SELECT a.pattern_id AS a, b.pattern_id AS b, a.rank AS a_rank, b.rank AS b_rank, a.episodes > b.episodes AS a_episodes, NOT drop_breadth AND a.b1 > b.b1 AS a_breadth, NOT drop_increase AND a.delta > b.delta AS a_change, b.episodes > a.episodes AS b_episodes, NOT drop_breadth AND b.b1 > a.b1 AS b_breadth, NOT drop_increase AND b.delta > a.delta AS b_change, FALSE AS b_listed, 1 AS section FROM first_candidate a CROSS JOIN ranked b JOIN outside_candidates o ON b.pattern_id = o.pattern_id CROSS JOIN availability WHERE o.conflict_rank <= $11::BIGINT), conflicts AS (SELECT * FROM listed_conflicts UNION ALL SELECT * FROM outside_conflicts), leader_values AS (SELECT 'episodes' AS criterion, pattern_id, rank, episodes AS value FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT 'breadth', pattern_id, rank, b1 FROM ranked CROSS JOIN availability WHERE NOT drop_breadth UNION ALL SELECT 'increase', pattern_id, rank, delta FROM ranked CROSS JOIN availability WHERE NOT drop_increase UNION ALL SELECT 'events', pattern_id, rank, events FROM ranked), leader_maxima AS (SELECT *, max(value) OVER (PARTITION BY criterion) AS best FROM leader_values), leaders AS (SELECT *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY criterion) AS tied, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY criterion ORDER BY rank, pattern_id) AS leader_rank FROM leader_maxima WHERE value = best) SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'pattern' AS record_kind, pattern_id AS pattern_id, pattern AS pattern, dataset AS dataset, component AS component, coalesce((SELECT o.team FROM ownership o WHERE o.dataset = ranked.dataset AND o.component = ranked.component), 'unowned') AS team, events AS events, episodes AS episodes, active_days AS active_days, active_weeks AS active_weeks, b1 AS b1, b2 AS b2, components AS components, example_event_id AS example_event_id, baseline AS baseline, delta AS delta, recurring AS recurring, status AS status, strftime(first_before, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS first_seen_before_window, strftime(first_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS first_seen, strftime(last_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS last_seen, events::DOUBLE / NULLIF((SELECT total FROM totals), 0) AS share, (SELECT total FROM totals) AS total, (SELECT active FROM totals) AS active, (SELECT quiet FROM totals) AS quiet, NULL::BIGINT AS candidates_checked, NULL::BIGINT AS missing_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS drop_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS drop_increase, NULL::BIGINT AS not_dominated_by_first, NULL::VARCHAR AS first_pattern_id, NULL::BIGINT AS compared_with, NULL::BOOLEAN AS truncated, NULL::BIGINT AS qualifying, NULL::VARCHAR AS criterion, NULL::BIGINT AS value, NULL::BIGINT AS tied, NULL::VARCHAR AS a, NULL::VARCHAR AS b, NULL::BOOLEAN AS a_episodes, NULL::BOOLEAN AS a_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS a_change, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_episodes, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_change, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_listed, NULL::BIGINT AS sort_section, rank AS sort_a, NULL::BIGINT AS sort_b FROM ranked WHERE rank <= $12::BIGINT UNION ALL SELECT 'summary' AS record_kind, NULL::VARCHAR AS pattern_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS pattern, NULL::VARCHAR AS dataset, NULL::VARCHAR AS component, NULL::VARCHAR AS team, NULL::BIGINT AS events, NULL::BIGINT AS episodes, NULL::BIGINT AS active_days, NULL::BIGINT AS active_weeks, NULL::BIGINT AS b1, NULL::BIGINT AS b2, NULL::BIGINT AS components, NULL::BIGINT AS example_event_id, NULL::BIGINT AS baseline, NULL::BIGINT AS delta, NULL::BOOLEAN AS recurring, NULL::VARCHAR AS status, NULL::VARCHAR AS first_seen_before_window, NULL::VARCHAR AS first_seen, NULL::VARCHAR AS last_seen, NULL::DOUBLE AS share, (SELECT total FROM totals)::BIGINT AS total, candidates_checked AS active, (SELECT quiet FROM totals)::BIGINT AS quiet, candidates_checked AS candidates_checked, missing_breadth AS missing_breadth, drop_breadth AS drop_breadth, drop_increase AS drop_increase, not_dominated_by_first AS not_dominated_by_first, (SELECT pattern_id FROM first_candidate) AS first_pattern_id, greatest(candidates_checked - 1, 0) AS compared_with, candidates_checked > $12::BIGINT AS truncated, candidates_checked AS qualifying, NULL::VARCHAR AS criterion, NULL::BIGINT AS value, NULL::BIGINT AS tied, NULL::VARCHAR AS a, NULL::VARCHAR AS b, NULL::BOOLEAN AS a_episodes, NULL::BOOLEAN AS a_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS a_change, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_episodes, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_change, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_listed, NULL::BIGINT AS sort_section, NULL::BIGINT AS sort_a, NULL::BIGINT AS sort_b FROM availability CROSS JOIN dominance_summary UNION ALL SELECT 'leader' AS record_kind, pattern_id AS pattern_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS pattern, NULL::VARCHAR AS dataset, NULL::VARCHAR AS component, NULL::VARCHAR AS team, NULL::BIGINT AS events, NULL::BIGINT AS episodes, NULL::BIGINT AS active_days, NULL::BIGINT AS active_weeks, NULL::BIGINT AS b1, NULL::BIGINT AS b2, NULL::BIGINT AS components, NULL::BIGINT AS example_event_id, NULL::BIGINT AS baseline, NULL::BIGINT AS delta, NULL::BOOLEAN AS recurring, NULL::VARCHAR AS status, NULL::VARCHAR AS first_seen_before_window, NULL::VARCHAR AS first_seen, NULL::VARCHAR AS last_seen, NULL::DOUBLE AS share, NULL::BIGINT AS total, NULL::BIGINT AS active, NULL::BIGINT AS quiet, NULL::BIGINT AS candidates_checked, NULL::BIGINT AS missing_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS drop_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS drop_increase, NULL::BIGINT AS not_dominated_by_first, NULL::VARCHAR AS first_pattern_id, NULL::BIGINT AS compared_with, NULL::BOOLEAN AS truncated, a_change, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_episodes, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_breadth, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_change, NULL::BOOLEAN AS b_listed, NULL::BIGINT AS sort_section, rank AS sort_a, NULL::BIGINT AS sort_b FROM leaders WHERE leader_rank <= $13::BIGINT UNION ALL SELECT 'conflict' AS record_kind, NULL::VARCHAR AS pattern_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS pattern, NULL::VARCHAR AS dataset, NULL::VARCHAR AS component, NULL::VARCHAR AS team, NULL::BIGINT AS events, NULL::BIGINT AS episodes, NULL::BIGINT AS active_days, NULL::BIGINT AS active_weeks, NULL::BIGINT AS b1, NULL::BIGINT AS b2, NULL::BIGINT AS components, AS truncated, NULL::BIGINT AS qualifying, NULL::VARCHAR AS criterion, NULL::BIGINT AS value, NULL::BIGINT AS tied, a AS a, b AS b, a_episodes AS a_episodes, a_breadth AS a_breadth, a_change AS a_change, b_episodes AS b_episodes, b_breadth AS b_breadth, b_change AS b_change, b_listed AS b_listed, section AS sort_section, a_rank AS sort_a, b_rank AS sort_b FROM conflicts CROSS JOIN dominance_summary WHERE not_dominated_by_first > 0) records ORDER BY record_kind, sort_section, sort_a, sort_b, criterion, pattern_id, a, b

SELECT e.pattern_id, 'level' AS kind, e.level AS value, count(*) AS events FROM log_events e WHERE e.dataset = $1 AND (e.is_error OR e.is_alert) AND e.ts >= $2::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.ts < $3::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.pattern_id IN ($4, $5, $6) GROUP BY e.pattern_id, e.level UNION ALL SELECT e.pattern_id, 'label' AS kind, e.alert_label AS value, count(*) AS events FROM log_events e WHERE e.dataset = $1 AND (e.is_error OR e.is_alert) AND e.ts >= $2::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.ts < $3::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.pattern_id IN ($4, $5, $6) AND e.alert_label IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.pattern_id, e.alert_label ORDER BY pattern_id, kind, events DESC, value NULLS LAST
